items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Each Done-when item of brief E1b is tested: expired park + open reminder in one shape, omissions, ended snooze, same-day pair, triage only via read_all_items, shape pinned and documented.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Bad --on refused (exit 2); triage read failure returns reminders plus triageError; corrupt store lines counted; unreadable store exits 4.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: All output text redacted (secret shapes, URL credentials, PEM blocks, password=); control characters flattened in single-line fields; lone surrogates replaced.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 18 tests incl. real git worktree and a source scan; secret fixtures built from fragments.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One linear fold plus one triage read; no cap, no loops over history.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer due --json to WebUI consumer pinned by shape test; triage fields read through the real read_all_items in the tests.
